intro: Soft, breathable, and effortlessly stylish, this blue and white cotton throw adds warmth and charm to any space. Thoughtfully crafted, it blends modern aesthetics with cozy comfort for everyday living.

features.title: A cotton feel, a gentle touch
features.text: Crafted from breathable cotton, this throw provides unmatched softness, ensuring every touch feels like home while withstanding the test of time.

features.title: Mix, match, and make it yours
features.text: Add a splash of elegance with its blue and white hues, perfect for uplifting modern homes with timeless, versatile charm.

features.title: Effortless warmth all day long
features.text: Cosy yet practical, it keeps you comfortably warm during chilly nights and safeguards your furniture in style.

care: Dry clean recommended or Gentle Hand wash with mild detergent and cold water.
name: 50x70 Cotton Throw
